results.text: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not the text of the act] Placeholder paragraph 1: an example system used for a purpose listed in a placeholder annex is treated as belonging to the placeholder category. Placeholder paragraph 2: a provider who considers that such a system does not belong to the placeholder category shall document that assessment before the system is placed on the market.
